subject: Request: One-time launch rate carveout for Acme.ai - exec approval
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Request: One-time launch rate carveout for Acme.ai - exec approval

Hi Laura, Marissa —

Quick summary: Acme.ai is ready to sign but their legal / procurement asked for a timeboxed commercial concession tied to our longseq/multi-model launch gap. They need predictable unit pricing for first 90 days to commit to a multi-region pilot (US + EU) and shift two integrations to Redwood.

What I'm asking: Executive sign-off for a one-time launch carveout (either a temporary 20% per-token rate reduction for 90 days OR a capped $120k credit applied over first two invoices) so we can get them on the platform and land a $1.2M ARR three-quarter expansion commitment.

Rationale:
- Acme is a strategic reference for fintech vertical and will put Redwood in their partner marketplace.
- The delay to longseq support is a material roadmap gap for their live workloads; they asked for a commercial accommodation rather than wait.
- Sales/CS will own success metrics and we have a signed mutual action plan (see attachment).

Numbers: Attached spreadsheet shows two scenarios — discount-first-quarter vs capped credit. Estimated revenue impact in year 1 (net of expansion) is +$900k incremental ARR; short-term margin impact is ~2-3% on forecasted usage.

If you want, I can include a contract clause: limited to first 90 days, non-recurring, requires usage telemetry and a short term SLA for rollout target.

Attachments: acme_launch_mop.xlsx, discount_calc_v2.pdf

Thanks — can we get a green-light or conditions to pass to Procure?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Lead, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: One-time launch rate carveout for Acme.ai - exec approval

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise rundown and attachments. A couple of asks before I can sign off:

1) Finance please confirm the short-term margin tradeoff and a conservative downside if expansion does not materialize.
2) I want a clear milestone tied to this concession: if Acme does not hit the agreed pilot metrics by day 90, the concession ends and any remaining credit is void.
3) Precedent: provide one example of a previously approved, similar concession (high level) so we keep consistency.

If Rishi confirms the numbers and we include the milestone language in the SOW, I am comfortable with a capped credit option (prefer capped $ over open % discount). Approve with cap: $120k max, payable as an invoice credit across the first two bills.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial 
Redwood Inference

Looping in quick finance view.

Short answer: acceptable under conditions. Details:
- Scenario A (20% discount for 90 days): estimated gross revenue giveback ~$98k over 90 days at current forecast; downside if no expansion ~98k.
- Scenario B (capped $120k credit): limited P&L exposure to $120k (preferred).
- We should require a clawback clause for materially lower usage (less than 40% of forecasted tokens in the first 60 days) — prorate credit return.

Please add the following to the SOW/Sales Order:
- Credit cap: $120,000 total, applied as invoice credit over first two invoices.
- Pilot milestones: authentication + region replication + 10k sustained longseq tokens/day by day 60.
- Clawback: if usage <40% projected by day 60, remaining credit void and future discounts revoked.

If you add those, Laura, I support the capped-credit option.

-Rishi
Director, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: Acme.ai capped launch credit (conditions)

Karthik / Marissa —

Approve $120k capped launch credit for Acme.ai with the conditions Rishi outlined. Please:

- Add the pilot milestones and clawback language to the SOW and get Acme to initial the clause.
- CS to publish the telemetry checkpoint (day 30 / day 60) to the shared drive (link in metadata).
- Legal to add a one-line addendum limiting the concession to this specific agreement; no precedent-setting language.

Karthik, loop in the customer and procurement and move to signature once they initial the SOW line. Send me the final redline for visibility before signature.

Thanks — good work closing this.

Laura
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
